page: Amazon Web Services r8in.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance managed by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The hardware profile features an Intel processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, providing 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs via 2 threads per core under dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB RAM allocation per vCPU. No hardware accelerators are present, with a GPU count of zero.

The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage configurations for persistent disk operations. Connectivity includes a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided by default. Storage operations and network throughput both depend on the underlying Nitro system architecture to manage network and volume traffic.

With an 8 to 1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high processor clock speeds, resource density favors applications with substantial working-set memory requirements over raw local disk I/O. The absence of integrated NVMe disks represents an architectural tradeoff, directing primary storage handling to network volumes. This configuration is positioned for in-memory data caches, relational and transactional database management systems, memory-bound ETL pipelines, and real-time enterprise analytics.
